selection_basis: Chosen 2026-10-05 over all-MiniLM-L12-v2 and eight others (bge, arctic-embed, mxbai, granite base/multilingual, EmbeddingGemma, Qwen3-Embedding) on 4,000 ambiguous Wiktionary citations whose homograph an id or a Descendants list gives: best accuracy per runtime cost (84.6% vs 81.4% for MiniLM under the same scoring).
